components.gap: Supply a precise statement and written proof that P_{alpha'alpha'} cannot be defined without descriptions as a consequence of the independence of Axioms 7 and 8 (source S2 p.59), and of the two n.12 replacement claims (30^iota with 30^iota' replace Axiom 8 over 1-6^alpha; 30^iota alone replaces Axiom 8 over 1-7 and 9^alpha); every other proof required by the presentation is written.

blocker.ref: Exact unproved source claims: (a) the same-type predecessor P_{alpha'alpha'} cannot be defined without descriptions, said to follow from the independence of the axiom of infinity (Church1940 S2 p.59); (b) n.12 (S6 p.66): Church's claim that 30^iota and 30^iota' together replace Axiom 8 over 1-6^alpha, and Turing's claim that 30^iota alone replaces Axiom 8 over 1-7 and 9^alpha. The source gives no proof of any of them; the handbook reports them as unproved (041 body 617-637; 040 body 474-484). A precise formulation and full proof of each is an open mathematical step, not a writing gap closable from the held source; n.12's independence question is recorded by the source as open.
